summary: JavaScript userscript that extracts direct download URLs from major Chinese cloud storage services such as Baidu, Alibaba, and others.
usecases: Quickly download files from cloud storage without manual link parsing
Integrate into browser automation scripts for batch downloading
Enhance personal download workflows with one‑click access
ideas: Add a popup UI to display and copy download links
Combine with a download manager to auto‑save files to local storage
Extend support to additional cloud services or custom APIs
